column1: # Gauntlet enforcement list (retro rulings O5 and O7; 17-18 Oct 2026).
# A repo listed on a live line gets the refusals approvals.sh adds: a new round after an approval that still
# stands, a round narrowed to the files the approval did not cover (no round over a merge fix), and a finding
# dropped or downgraded without a passing test. Every other repo gets the same checks as warnings only.
# One live line per repo, three tab-separated fields:
#   owner/repo <TAB> slot wrapper or - <TAB> run-once field
# The third field is no longer read: the pre-review and the run-once were retired on 22 Nov 2026 (round 1 needs
# neither on any repo). It stays so the format does not change; `none` is its value.
# The wrapper prefixes every disposition test, for example a script that runs it in a test VM.
# A line starting with # is off. Going live is uncommenting a line.
